cases.explain: Богу is the indirect object of the verb петь (to sing), with the dative case indicating the recipient.
Иерусалим is the direct object of the transitive verb отстраивает (builds up), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он исцеляет разбитые ___ и перевязывает их раны.
cases.explain: Сердца is the direct object of the verb исцеляет (heals), taking the accusative plural case.
The genitive case звезд after количество (quantity/number) indicates the thing being counted or measured.

cases.sentence: Велик наш Владыка и могуществен, его разум не знает ___.
cases.explain: The genitive case границ with the negative verb не знает (does not know) indicates something unlimited.
The instrumental case благодарностью with the preposition с (with) indicates accompaniment or manner.
The dative case животным (or here животных as accusative object) indicates the recipient of the action дает (gives).
The prepositional case силе with the preposition в (in; implied here) indicates location or object of thought.

reading.ru: Как хорошо петь хвалу нашему Богу! Сладостно подобающая хвала!
reading.question: What does the psalmist say about singing praise to God?
reading.explain: The text states it is хорошо (good) and сладостно подобающая (pleasant and fitting) to praise God.

reading.ru: Господь отстраивает Иерусалим, собирает изгнанников Израиля.
reading.question: What does the Lord do for Jerusalem and Israel?
options: Rebuilds Jerusalem and gathers the dispersed Israelites
reading.correct: Rebuilds Jerusalem and gathers the dispersed Israelites
reading.explain: The verse says He отстраивает (rebuilds) Иерусалим and собирает (gathers) the изгнанников (exiles) of Israel.

reading.ru: Он исцеляет разбитые сердца и перевязывает их раны.
reading.question: What does the Lord do for those with broken hearts?
options: Heals their hearts and binds their wounds
reading.correct: Heals their hearts and binds their wounds
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states He исцеляет (heals) разбитые сердца (broken hearts) and перевязывает (binds) их раны (their wounds).

reading.ru: Он исчисляет количество звезд и называет их по именам.
reading.question: What remarkable things does God do with the stars?
options: Counts them and calls each by name
reading.correct: Counts them and calls each by name
reading.explain: The text says He исчисляет (counts) the количество (number) of звезд (stars) and называет их по именам (calls them by their names).

reading.ru: Велик наш Владыка и могуществен, его разум не знает границ.
reading.question: What is said about God's greatness and understanding?
options: He is great and mighty; his understanding is boundless
reading.correct: He is great and mighty; his understanding is boundless
reading.explain: The verse states He is велик (great) and могуществен (mighty), and his разум (understanding) не знает границ (knows no bounds).

reading.ru: Господь благосклонен к боящимся его, к надеющимся на его милость.
reading.question: Toward whom is the Lord favorable?
options: Those who fear him and hope in his mercy
reading.correct: Those who fear him and hope in his mercy
reading.explain: The verse says He is благосклонен (favorable) к боящимся его (to those who fear Him) and к надеющимся на его милость (to those who hope in His mercy).
